0022600003.text: Both the San Antonio Spurs and Oklahoma City Thunder open their 2026-27 seasons in this home game for the Spurs. The Spurs will be without Jayden Quaintance, who is out after knee surgery, and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain. The Thunder are missing Otega Oweh, who is out after Achilles surgery, while Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jaylin Williams, Nikola Topic and Thomas Sorber are all day-to-day, and the Spurs won the 2025-26 regular-season series 4-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-3, including a 111-103 win in Oklahoma City on May 30, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives San Antonio a 55% chance to win.
